connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.description: Repositories, issues, pull requests and code search.
connectors.free_note: Free with a GitHub account and a personal access token.

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.description: Search and edit pages and databases in your workspace.
connectors.free_note: Docs say it works on every plan; some limits depend on plan.

connectors.name: Atlassian Rovo
connectors.description: Jira, Confluence and Compass through one server.
connectors.free_note: Usage counts against Rovo credits; check your plan allowance.

connectors.name: Linear
connectors.description: Find, create and update Linear issues, projects and comments.
connectors.free_note: Works with any Linear account.

connectors.name: Asana
connectors.description: Work with tasks, projects and goals in Asana.
connectors.free_note: Docs do not state plan limits; you may need an Asana-issued client ID.

connectors.name: Figma
connectors.description: Read Figma designs and design context for code generation.
connectors.free_note: Only clients in the Figma MCP catalog may connect; plan limits are on Figma's rate-limit page.

connectors.name: Sentry
connectors.description: Look into errors, issues and releases in Sentry.
connectors.free_note: Needs a Sentry account (free plan exists).

connectors.name: Supabase
connectors.description: Manage Supabase projects, databases and edge functions.
connectors.free_note: Free with any Supabase account.

connectors.name: Vercel
connectors.description: Search docs, manage projects and read deployment logs.
connectors.free_note: Docs: available on all plans.

connectors.name: Render
connectors.description: Manage Render services, databases and logs.
connectors.free_note: Needs a Render account and API key.

connectors.name: Cloudflare API
connectors.description: Call the whole Cloudflare API from one server.
connectors.free_note: Needs a Cloudflare account (free plan exists).

connectors.name: Cloudflare Docs
connectors.description: Search the Cloudflare documentation.
connectors.free_note: Public documentation search.

connectors.name: Stripe
connectors.description: Stripe API tools and documentation search.
connectors.free_note: Needs a Stripe account; sandbox accounts are free.

connectors.name: PayPal
connectors.description: PayPal payments, invoices and orders tools.
connectors.free_note: Needs a PayPal developer account; sandbox is free.

connectors.name: Neon
connectors.description: Manage Neon Postgres projects, branches and run SQL.
connectors.free_note: Needs a Neon account; docs do not state plan limits.

connectors.name: Prisma Postgres
connectors.description: Manage Prisma Postgres databases.
connectors.free_note: Needs a Prisma account and workspace.

connectors.name: Upstash
connectors.description: Manage Upstash Redis and QStash resources.
connectors.free_note: Needs an Upstash account (free tier exists).

connectors.name: Clerk
connectors.description: Manage Clerk applications, users and SDK snippets.
connectors.free_note: Needs a Clerk Dashboard account.

connectors.name: MongoDB
connectors.description: Query MongoDB and manage Atlas through the official local server.

connectors.free_note: Open source. Atlas tools need an Atlas account (free tier exists); credentials are optional.

connectors.name: Context7
connectors.description: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples.
connectors.free_note: Works without a key; a free key raises rate limits.

connectors.name: Microsoft Learn
connectors.description: Search Microsoft documentation and code samples.
connectors.free_note: Docs: no authentication and no charge.

connectors.name: Exa Search
connectors.description: Web search and page fetch built for AI.
connectors.free_note: Docs: search and fetch work without a key at a free rate limit.

connectors.name: Tavily
connectors.description: Web search and content extraction.
connectors.free_note: Free account available; limits not stated in the docs.

connectors.name: Firecrawl
connectors.description: Scrape, crawl and extract web pages.
connectors.free_note: Needs an API key; the docs do not state free-tier limits.

connectors.name: Brave Search
connectors.description: Web, news and local search with the Brave Search API.
connectors.free_note: Needs an API key; the README does not state a free tier.

connectors.name: DuckDuckGo Search
connectors.description: Keyless web search and page fetch.
connectors.free_note: Open source community server, no key.

connectors.name: Playwright
connectors.description: Drive a real browser with Playwright.
connectors.free_note: Open source, runs locally.

connectors.name: Chrome DevTools
connectors.description: Debug and inspect pages in Chrome.
connectors.free_note: Open source, runs locally.

connectors.name: Filesystem
connectors.description: Read and write files in an allowed folder.
connectors.free_note: Open source reference server.

connectors.name: Fetch
connectors.description: Fetch web pages and convert them to markdown.
connectors.free_note: Open source reference server.

connectors.name: Git
connectors.description: Read, search and manipulate a Git repository.
connectors.free_note: Open source reference server.

connectors.name: Memory
connectors.description: Knowledge-graph memory that persists across chats.
connectors.free_note: Open source reference server.

connectors.name: Sequential Thinking
connectors.description: Step-by-step reasoning scratchpad.
connectors.free_note: Open source reference server.

connectors.name: Time
connectors.description: Current time and time zone conversion.
connectors.free_note: Open source reference server.

connectors.name: Everything (test server)
connectors.description: Demo server that exercises every MCP feature; handy for testing.
connectors.free_note: Open source reference server.

connectors.name: AWS MCP Server
connectors.description: Managed AWS server: search AWS docs and call AWS APIs, signed in with your AWS account.
connectors.free_note: Needs an AWS account and the AWSMCPSignInOAuthAccessPolicy on your IAM user or role. AWS usage is billed as usual; the server's own pricing is not stated on the setup page.

connectors.name: AWS MCP Server (AWS CLI sign-in)
connectors.description: Same AWS server through a local signing proxy: uses your AWS CLI login, supports several accounts and a default region.
connectors.free_note: Needs uv, AWS CLI 2.32+ and `aws login` first. AWS usage is billed as usual.

connectors.name: AWS Documentation
connectors.description: Search and read AWS documentation pages as markdown. No AWS account needed.
connectors.free_note: Open source; reads public AWS documentation, no credentials.

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.description: Search and read Gmail messages and threads, create drafts and manage labels.
connectors.free_note: Google Workspace Developer Preview server; needs a Google account, a Google Cloud project with the gmailmcp.googleapis.com service enabled and your own OAuth web client created with 'Use this client for an AI-powered agent' (scopes: gmail.readonly, gmail.compose). Docs state no pricing.

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.description: List calendars, search events, suggest times and create or update events in Google Calendar.
connectors.free_note: Google Workspace Developer Preview server; needs a Google account, a Google Cloud project with the calendarmcp.googleapis.com service enabled and your own OAuth web client created with 'Use this client for an AI-powered agent' (scopes: calendar.calendarlist.readonly, calendar.events.readonly, calendar.events.freebusy). Docs state no pricing.

connectors.name: Google Drive
connectors.description: Search, read and create files in Google Drive.
connectors.free_note: Google Workspace Developer Preview server; needs a Google account, a Google Cloud project with the drivemcp.googleapis.com service enabled and your own OAuth web client created with 'Use this client for an AI-powered agent' (scopes: drive.readonly, drive.file). Docs state no pricing.

connectors.name: Google Docs
connectors.description: Read and edit Google Docs documents.
connectors.free_note: Google Workspace Developer Preview server; needs a Google account, a Google Cloud project with the docsmcp.googleapis.com service enabled and your own OAuth web client created with 'Use this client for an AI-powered agent' (scopes: documents, drive.file). Docs state no pricing.

connectors.name: Google Sheets
connectors.description: Read and update Google Sheets spreadsheets.
connectors.free_note: Google Workspace Developer Preview server; needs a Google account, a Google Cloud project with the sheetsmcp.googleapis.com service enabled and your own OAuth web client created with 'Use this client for an AI-powered agent' (scopes: spreadsheets, drive.file). Docs state no pricing.

connectors.name: Google Slides
connectors.description: Read and edit Google Slides presentations.
connectors.free_note: Google Workspace Developer Preview server; needs a Google account, a Google Cloud project with the slidesmcp.googleapis.com service enabled and your own OAuth web client created with 'Use this client for an AI-powered agent' (scopes: presentations, drive.file). Docs state no pricing.

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.description: Search and read channels, threads and canvases, and send messages in Slack.
connectors.free_note: Slack does not support dynamic client registration: you need a Slack app (directory-published or internal) and its client ID/secret (/mcp add --client-id), plus workspace admin approval. Docs state no plan requirement.

connectors.name: TextToQuant
connectors.description: Parse trading strategies from plain English, run backtests on market data and read the reports.
connectors.free_note: Needs a TextToQuant account. Docs say the MCP connector is on every plan; the free plan has only 5 one-time backtests and some markets (stocks, forex, futures) need a paid plan.

connectors.name: Wispr Flow
connectors.description: Read your Wispr Flow meetings, transcripts, scratchpad notes and calendar events (read-only).
connectors.free_note: Needs a Wispr Flow account with Notetaker and MCP access (Mac or Windows app); docs do not say which plans include it. Does not expose dictation history.
